description:
PACHATECH busca proteger la agricultura frente al cambio climático mediante la creación de una herramienta web que utilice datos de la NASA para visualizar condiciones climáticas y explorar alternativas de cultivos en Cusco.

PACHATECH aims to protect agriculture from climate change by developing a web tool that uses NASA data to visualize weather conditions and explore alternative crops in Cusco.
summary: AgriClimate is a platform that supports farmers and students by helping them visualize climate conditions and explore local crop alternatives using NASA data. The website provides comparisons between NASA sources (NASA POWER) and local data, as well as statistical information, crop rotation suggestions, and soil diagnostics tailored to the Cusco region. Our project is significant because many farmers in Peru find it difficult to interpret data from meteorological organizations. In short, AgriClimate is a platform that translates meteorological data into a format that is easily understood by farmers and students.
details:
Agroclimate provides farmers with easy-to-understand data and offers recommendations for crop rotation to protect the soil and improve crop yields—all through an accessible website.
1) It helps farmers understand favorable growing conditions and the importance of crop rotation.
2) It provides a land assessment, complete with easy-to-interpret statistics.
3) It informs those who depend on agriculture for their livelihood, enabling them to prepare for the El Niño phenomenon. -
4)It supports farmers by keeping them informed about climatic conditions on their land, allowing them to prepare for potential climate shifts and the El Niño phenomenon through effective crop rotation and soil management.

5)HTML and JavaScript.

6)It is an innovative solution that offers a simple approach for farmers. - Elevation above sea level, humidity, temperature, and land assessment.
